PASS-WITH-NOTES — static performance/285, exact head 83e0554bb3d413d0215563fb8774f0dfa4f122e0, base14226920.

The quoted PR-body cost row is confirmed. No blocking performance finding. Exact HEAD and full three-file delta inspected. No builds/tests, benchmark, live measurement or daemon changes by this seat.

LIVE_OF_KINDS_SQL binds the existing kind JSON and selects only1/LIMIT1 under state pending OR running. Existing jobs_claimable(state,kind,id) covers the lookup. Schema, empty-kind and lease validation precede it. On absence, the function returns before worker allocation, owned_write and BEGIN IMMEDIATE. A delayed, expired-running or serial-blocked live row still takes the original transaction path.

| Plain Queue::claim, scoped empty kinds | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Explicit queue SQL commands | 6 | 2 |
| Pool checkouts | 2 | 2 |
| Queue-owned write task | 1 | 0 |
| Write transaction/write-lock acquisition | 1 | 0 |

The two remaining commands are the retained schema PRAGMA and indexed preflight. A nonempty pass gains exactly one preflight read and one pool checkout, then retains the original recovery/claim work. Pool housekeeping, native mutex/recipient reads and read waits remain; this is not zero-cost or allocation-free HTTP handling.

[INFERENCE] On the unchanged timer-only500ms idle path, each waiting native seat does about2 preflights/s and avoids about2 empty write admissions/s when its scoped queue is truly empty; notifications can add passes. No new loop, timer, process launch site or mutex. No migration/new index. spawn_sites.rs and delivery timing/notification code are unchanged.

Test SOURCE covers no-write under a held SQLite writer, plain and extension claims, pending delivery, expired running recovery, delayed/serial-blocked rows, other-kind isolation and a5000-row indexed query plan. Performance did not execute these tests. The earlier F234 read-only plan also supported this predicate; no final-head runtime plan claim is made.

Nonblocking wording correction: Copilot's production branch uses plain Queue::claim. The test helper/ledger label extension-lease renew/parking UPDATEs as native work; those extras belong to OMP/Pi claim_extension, not the plain Copilot baseline above.

Live after-proof remains as requested after merge/bounce: compare window delta_active_us/delta_count with117.048ms, alongside held/count, request rate and daemon CPU. No latency/CPU-saving magnitude is inferred from statement counts. References: queue.rs:96-135,300-303; queue_empty_claim.rs:91-284; migrations/0002_queue.sql:39; delivery/mod.rs:2083-2133.
